name: oneway-beyond-the-concurrency-limit-is-dropped
description: A oneway open beyond the receiver's concurrency limit is dropped without invoking the handler and without a frame (WSM-STM-040): reset(REFUSED), which WSM-STM-036 sends for an ordinary open, would be read by nobody. The connection survives and the first stream still works. max_concurrent_streams is an instruction to the runner, never a wire value (WSM-CON-031).
